snippet.title: Isle of Food | Announce Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist VR cooking game Isle of Food on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4072850/?utm_source=yt&utm_medium=trailer

Wishlist Isle of Food on Meta:
https://www.meta.com/experiences/isle-of-food/31091861580461807/?utm_source=yt&utm_medium=trailer

Coming to Meta Quest, SteamVR and PlayStation VR2.

Can you cook when nothing is given to you? Hunt, fish, gather, and farm your way to running a stylish island restaurant in this open-world cozy VR cooking game!

Core Gameplay:
✔ VR cooking with natural hand interactions
✔ 100+ real and fantasy recipes
✔ Multiple cooking methods: baking, boiling, frying, grilling
✔ Open-world island exploration
✔ Hunting, Fishing, Gathering, Farming
✔ Day–night cycle and dynamic weather
✔ Restaurant management, upgrades, decorations and progression

Follow Isle of Food:
Website: https://istifagames.com/
Discord: https://discord.gg/vK8F5Wy66u
Twitter/X: https://x.com/IstifaGames
TikTok: https://tiktok.com/@isleoffood
